body.message:
My apologies, yes, we do work with external agents.

If you have a client, please share the number of bedrooms required, preferred dates, and any specific location preferences. We will then share the available options and quotation with you if anything available.

Please note that if you require a commission, it would need to be added on top of the quoted amount. This is how our process works for external agents.

Thank you, and we look forward to working with you.
